name: SQL case studies
title: SQL case studies
description: Put your SQL skills to the test. Get better at intermediate level Analytics using the case studies given in this practice path

modules.name: Case Study - Cinema Hall
modules.description: Refine SQL skills by analyzing movie theatre booking data, customer preferences and movie trends for valuable insights.

modules.name: Case Study - Online Education Courses
modules.description: Boost SQL skills with hands-on analysis of an online education platform's dataset, examining course popularity, instructor performance, and subscriber information.

modules.name: Case Study - Fantasy Role Playing Game
modules.description: Master the art of manipulating and retrieving data from a fantasy role-playing game's database using SQL queries.

modules.name: Case Study - Company Recession
modules.description: Analyze company data to understand operations, including financial performance, workforce composition, sectors, and headquarters, enabling informed decisions even during recessions.

modules.name: Case Study -  Sales Analysis of E-commerce Platform
modules.description: Enhance SQL skills while analyzing a comprehensive dataset to gain insights into e-commerce sales and customer behavior, enabling data-driven decision-making for optimizing the online marketplace.

modules.name: Case Study - Music App
modules.description: Level up your SQL skills by extracting valuable insights from data analysis to maximize the music app's potential in the digital music industry.
